name: inspect_material_figures

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,base64,json
from pathlib import Path
L=Path.cwd()
for name,page in [('threads',11),('tutte-final',32),('rightgroups',9)]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1100','-singlefile','-png',str(L/'sources'/f'{name}.pdf')],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 s=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode();w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),f'figures/{name}-p{page}.png','--base64'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('IMAGE '+name+' '+s)
